# onyx_user_groups (Data Source)

All user groups, including the seeded `Admin` and `Basic` groups that `onyx_user_group` cannot create. Use it to reference a group by name. Enterprise Edition only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "onyx_user_groups" "all" {}

locals {
  basic_group_id = one([for g in data.onyx_user_groups.all.groups : g.id if g.name == "Basic"])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `groups` (Attributes List) The groups, sorted by id. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--groups))

<a id="nestedatt--groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `groups`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Numeric group id.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether Onyx seeded the group (`Admin`, `Basic`).
- `is_up_to_date` (Boolean) False while Onyx syncs the group's access to the search index.
- `name` (String) Group name.
